title: 第一卷 第1629章 四品神傀第一卷 第1628章 异魔妖龙
slug: 叛出家族后转身投靠魔族女帝
lines: 轰！
就在此时，其身体之中，有着一股狂暴的气息扑面而来。
一口巨大的鼎出现。
七圣绝魔鼎的出现，让妖龙还是吃了一惊。
关键时刻，七圣绝魔鼎出来护主。
鼎中，喷射出来，无数的魔纹，形成一道道魔锁，向着这头妖龙锁去。
妖龙看到这一幕之后，多少还是吃了一惊的。
可是很快就平静了下来。
因为这七圣绝魔鼎，虽然强大，可是到底是在他的地盘，还是被限制了。
就算是这些魔锁把妖龙给锁住了，但是这头妖龙依然是一点也不怕。
这一点点的禁制，对于他来说真的不算什么。
这头妖龙，轻轻松松地就可以破解了眼前的局面。
妖龙周身散发出暗色的光泽，周身一阵摇动。
龙鳞一片片地闪动，瞬间就把魔锁给震飞了。
七圣绝魔鼎发出极为刺耳的嗡鸣之声。
直接就向着妖龙撞击而来。
其上魔纹，神纹此时不停地闪烁着。
但是妖龙一阵怒吼，一记龙尾之击，瞬间就把这七圣绝魔鼎打入到了潭水深处。
七圣绝魔鼎周身的光芒，瞬间就开始暗淡了起来。
此时无法护主。
楚尘周身此时已经被冰封，妖龙来到楚尘的面前，微微一吸，楚尘就已经来到了他的面前。
“真是不好意思。”
“你终究还是要被我吃了。”
“不过我承认，你很强。”
“强得有些离谱。”
“到底是境界，有些低了，限制了你的发挥。”
妖龙张开巨口，瞬间就要把楚尘给吸入到腹中，成为美食。
楚尘整个人都是懵的。
眼看着就要被妖龙给吞噬。
楚尘被动之下，激活了混沌神体。
嗡的一声响。
一道黄色的光流，瞬间就把妖龙整个给包裹住了。
妖龙一惊，想要反抗之时，却是发现楚尘此时竟然站了起来。
开始不停地吞噬起了他周身的生机。
“这，这是为什么啊？”
妖龙一头雾水的问道。
“此乃是我的混沌神体。”
“自带吞噬万物的能力。”
“你只是不小心触发了它。”
“不好意思，你的所有之一切，都要被我吸收。”
楚尘感受到一股股，极为澎湃的能量，此时源源不断地吸收到他的身体之中。
这妖龙一身精纯的能量，飞快的消逝着。
妖龙一脸不敢相信的看着这一幕。
“这，这，这不可能。”
content_en:
boom!
At this moment, a violent aura rushed towards his body.
A huge cauldron appeared.
The appearance of the Seven Saints Absolute Demon Cauldron still surprised the demon dragon.
At the critical moment, the Seven Saints and the Demon Cauldron came out to protect the Lord.
From the cauldron, countless magic patterns were sprayed out, forming a series of magic locks, locking towards the demonic dragon.
After the demon dragon saw this scene, he was somewhat surprised.
But it soon calmed down.
Because although the Seven Saints Absolute Demon Cauldron is powerful, it is still restricted in his territory.
Even though these magic locks locked the demon dragon, the demon dragon was still not afraid at all.
This little restriction is really nothing to him.
This demonic dragon could easily solve the situation in front of him.
The demonic dragon's whole body exuded a dark luster, and its whole body shook.
The dragon scales flashed one by one, and the magic lock was instantly blown away.
The Seven Saints Absolute Demon Cauldron made an extremely harsh buzzing sound.
It hit the demonic dragon directly.
The magic patterns and divine patterns on it were flashing continuously at this time.
But the demonic dragon roared and struck with its tail, instantly driving the Seven Saints and Demonic Cauldron into the depths of the pond.
The light around the Seven Saints Absolute Demon Cauldron began to dim instantly.
There is no way to protect the Lord at this time.
Chu Chen's whole body was already frozen. The demon dragon came to Chu Chen. With a slight breath, Chu Chen had already arrived in front of him.
"I'm so sorry."
"You will still be eaten by me after all."
"But I admit, you are strong."
"It's ridiculously strong."
"After all, it's your level that's a little low, which limits your performance."
The demonic dragon opened its huge mouth and was about to suck Chu Chen into its belly in an instant and turn it into a delicacy.
Chu Chen was completely confused.
He was about to be swallowed by the demon dragon.
Chu Chen passively activated the Chaos Divine Body.
There was a buzzing sound.
A stream of yellow light instantly enveloped the entire demonic dragon.
The demon dragon was startled and wanted to resist, but found that Chu Chen actually stood up at this time.
It began to swallow up the vitality around him.
"Why, why is this?"
The demon dragon asked confused.
"This is my Chaos Divine Body."
"It has the ability to devour all things."
"You just accidentally triggered it."
"I'm sorry, everything you have will be absorbed by me."
Chu Chen felt waves of extremely surging energy, which was continuously absorbed into his body.
The pure energy of this demonic dragon disappeared quickly.
The demon dragon looked at this scene with disbelief.
"This, this, this is impossible."
